I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 24 July renewal date for Tansleigh Packaging.

- **What I checked:** only what Ilse can see herself. That's the #north-team history, the North team summaries, the North cheat sheet and the public files.
- **What I found:** none of them mentions a renewal date for Tansleigh. Tansleigh also isn't listed as a North account in any of them.
- **What I told her:** I'll keep the date marked as unconfirmed hearsay and won't record it anywhere as real. The account owner or June Osei-Lark on the deal desk can check it against the contract.

I didn't look at channels Ilse isn't in, I didn't use message search, and I didn't mention anything only I can see. No approval was needed, since a renewal date isn't a finance figure.
